about.beta_body: This is an open-beta build (OB1.0.0). Features may still change or need a tweak on your side. Provided as-is — the author is not on the hook for lost data or unexpected downtime. Keep backups, use sensible passwords, and look after your own host and network. Try it, break it kindly, and tell us what to improve.
about.bug_body: Tell me what exploded. Screenshots are pure gold.
about.changelog.api: REST API v1:Maɓalli-ingantattun wuraren ƙarewa a ƙarƙashin ƙirar izini iri ɗaya, don haɗawa da duk abin da ke gudana akan bene.
about.changelog.assets: Rijistar Kadari tare da Takaddun Jiki:Cikakkun OEM/ garanti/rakodin rayuwa, da QR & DataMatrix buga lakabin - lodin layi na layi don Zebra ko kowane firintar takarda, babu intanet da ake buƙata.
about.changelog.design: Tsarin Tsara Haɗe-haɗe:Kallo ɗaya mai nuna alama a cikin kowane nau'i - AA-kwatancen rubutu, dangi guda ɗaya / maɓalli / lamba, Haske / duhu na gaskiya, da bangon WebGL wanda za'a iya kashe akan tsofaffin injuna.
about.changelog.inventory: Inventory with Real Ledger:Kowane motsi - cin tikiti, amfani da odar aiki, PO samu - ana yin rikodin kuma ana iya gano shi zuwa aikin da ya haifar da shi.
about.changelog.notif: Fadakarwa & Hanyar Audit:Faɗakarwar mai amfani don yarda, ƙaramin jari da aikin da bai ƙare ba, tare da madaidaicin rajistan rajista a bayansu.
about.changelog.procurement: Siyayya, Ƙarshe zuwa Ƙarshe:Buƙatu → amincewar farashi → cikar ma'aji → rasidin kaya → sulhunta kasafin kuɗi, tare da madaidaicin mataki tara da cikakken tarihin matsayi.
about.changelog.rbac: Granular RBAC: 24 permissions across 6 editable roles, enforced server-side on every page and API endpoint — including separate tooling rights and a Storekeeper who can fulfil orders but never approve their cost.
about.changelog.reorder: Sake yin oda-Aiki-Tsarin Taimako:Amfanin da ke sauke sashi zuwa mafi ƙarancinsa yana ɗaga buƙatu ta atomatik, ta hanyar ƙa'idodin yarda ɗaya kamar na jagora.
about.changelog.security: Ƙarfafa ta Default:CSRF akan canje-canje na jihohi, shirye-shiryen maganganun gabaɗaya, daidaita zaman da kare-ƙarfi, da Evil Maid yana kulle ɗaurin ɗauka da rufewa ga ingantaccen mai amfani.
about.changelog.tickets: Cikakken Rayuwar Tikiti:Yi rijista → takeover → ayyukan shiga → rufewa → tarihin bincike, tare da kama lokaci a kowane mataki don haka ana auna MTTA da MTTR, ba a kimanta ba.
about.changelog.ux: Na'ura-Aware UX:Yanayin hannu yana kunna ta atomatik - allunan sun rushe cikin katunan, kalanda ya zama ajanda, kuma maƙasudin taɓawa suna girma zuwa girman safofin hannu.
about.changelog.wo: Umarnin Aiki & Kulawa na Rigakafi:Jadawalai masu maimaitawa, jerin abubuwan da za a sake amfani da su, duba kalanda, da gano lokacin da ya wuce wanda ke bayyana abin da ya zame.
about.chat_body: Ideas, questions, or plant-floor war stories — all welcome.
about.feat.analytics: Binciken KPI & MTTR na ainihin lokaci
about.feat.analytics_body: Yana tara danyen na'urorin sadarwa na shiga tsakani don ƙididdige Ma'anar Lokacin Gyara MTTR, waƙa da lokacin ragewa, sa ido kan aikin ƙwararru, da hangen nesa da amfani da sassa akan lokaci.
about.feat.assets_body: Yana kiyaye ainihin CMMS tsarin mahalli ta hanyar matsayi na kai-da-kai. Ana haɗa injina da ƙananan majalisu kai tsaye zuwa kayan aikin su ta hanyar lissafin kayan aiki BOM.
about.feat.docs_body: Amintaccen ma'auni, sadaukarwa don Tsaron SOPs, Littattafan Fasaha, da Blueprints. Yana aiwatar da ingantacciyar nau'in MIME da keɓantaccen takaddar don tabbatar da mahimman takaddun aminci koyaushe ana samun dama ta kai tsaye daga shafin kadari.
about.feat.inventory: Kayayyakin Kayan Aiki & Sake yin oda ta atomatik
about.feat.inventory_body: Yana bin cikakkun bayanan dabaru, matakan hannun jari, da filayen yarda. Yana da tsarin sake yin odar sifili ta atomatik wanda ke haifar da lokacin da hannun jari ya faɗi ƙasa ƙayyadaddun ƙofofin.
about.feat.lines: Layukan Samar da Kayayyaki & Tsari-tsare na kanti
about.feat.lines_body: Cikakkun tsarin gudanarwa na bita-zuwa-layi-zuwa kayan aiki. Layukan samarwa 'yan ƙasa ne na farko tare da ƙididdige injin, bin diddigin matsayi, da haɗa kai tsaye cikin odar aiki da kayan aiki.
about.feat.modular_body: Cikakken sake tsarawa cikin manyan fayilolin yanki na ma'ana (_mgmt, _maint, _eam, _prod, _logi, _rpt da dai sauransu) don kiyayewa da haɓaka gaba. Duk nassoshi, sun haɗa, da sabunta kewayawa.
about.feat.pm_body: Injin tsara shirye-shirye mai aiki don Kulawa da Kariya PM. Yana bibiyar ayyukan yau da kullun da ba a ƙare ba ta atomatik, yana daidaitawa sosai don hutun shuka, kuma yana ganin nauyin aiki akan kalanda mai mu'amala.
about.feat.procurement_body: Yana daidaita cikakken sarkar saye. Buƙatun Sayen Cikin Gida (PRs) ya ƙaru zuwa odar siyayya ta yau da kullun (POs) da aka aika wa dillalai, tare da kiyaye rajistan binciken IATF mai yarda da bayanan 9 daban-daban na PO.
about.feat.rbac_body: Tsarin izini na darajar ciniki yana tuƙi cikakken tsaro. Daga granular module damar zuwa Evil Maid Kariya hana satar zaman ba tare da izini ba yayin ɗaukar tikiti da rufewa.
about.feat.tickets_body: Yana sarrafa kurakuran masana'antu daga farkon rajista zuwa aikin injiniya da ƙuduri na ƙarshe. Yana goyan bayan shigarwa kai tsaye don gyare-gyare da sauri.
about.indykb_blurb: An ƙirƙira don ƙwararrun masu fasaha suna musayar ilimi a cikin matakanmu, kuma ana samun su kyauta ga duk wanda ke buƙatar ci gaba da tafiyar da layukan samarwa a duk duniya.

about.license_title: License (plant use welcome — not for resale as a product)
about.privacy_body: WCC is built for local / on-prem installs. It does not phone home, and it does not collect your plant data for anyone else. Tickets, assets, users, and files live in your database on your host. How safe that is depends on your own network, firewall, accounts, and backups — not on a cloud we control, because there isn’t one.
about.privacy_title: Runs on your machine — your data stays yours
about.release_intro: Open beta OB1.0.0 — the modules below are built, wired end to end, and exercised on plant-style data. Expect polish as the beta matures.
about.welcome: Barka da zuwa Cibiyar Kula da Bita WCC. Wannan ba kawai wani kumbura ba ne na software na kamfani da aka tsara a cikin ɗakin kwana- babban aiki ne, ⟦CMMS wanda ba shi da tsari wanda aka ƙirƙira kai tsaye a benen masana'anta. Masu fasaha da injiniyoyi ne suka gina su, DON masu fasaha da injiniyoyi, WCC yana cire mataccen nauyi na kamfani don isar da abin da ke da mahimmanci:cikakken saurin aiwatarwa. An ƙirƙira shi don aiki a gefen, yana lalata bayanan ƙofa, sanya kayan aikin don gudanar da cikakken tsarin rayuwar tikiti, bin mahimman ƙira, da bincika KPIs na ainihi kai tsaye a cikin hannunku.
